description: HTML source for a web-based database viewer interface. It includes structure, styling, and client-side JavaScript to load and display database information dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables of a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on its data type and size.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full viewing.
